shared_representation_contract.simple_values: Authored scalar and homogeneous scalar-list values are ordinary Neo4j properties unless their names collide with graph bookkeeping.
shared_representation_contract.nested_values: Nested maps, mixed arrays and arrays of objects use escaped JSON Pointer property keys; indexes preserve list ordering and object association.
shared_representation_contract.null_absence_empty: Absent source keys stay absent. Explicit null paths and empty containers are recorded separately by _native_null_paths, _native_empty_paths and the shape manifest.
shared_representation_contract.collisions: Authored id, title, kind, current, components and other reserved names use pointer keys such as /id and /components. They cannot overwrite canonical graph identity, provenance or current-generation flags.
shared_representation_contract.types: The shape manifest preserves native scalar types, dates versus date-like strings, containers and typed YAML map keys. Unsupported values fail explicitly.
shared_representation_contract.derived_and_supporting_sources: Template fields, manifest context, body-derived metadata and presentation fallbacks remain separately namespaced with provenance; never overwrite the primary authored mapping.
shared_representation_contract.schema_requirements: Required-for-new-authoring fields and actually authored legacy fields are distinct. No defaults, inferred lifecycle, implicit ownership or successful execution claims are added.
shared_representation_contract.source_authority: Only records read from the selected immutable source may populate a published generation. Working-tree review counts and pending-merge parity checks do not establish published counts.

aura_publication.owner: Root integration task must record the selected immutable SHA, apply result, readback verification and counts separately. No reader receipt is evidence of deployment.

not_independent_types.name: KnownIssue, Retrospective, Memory, Architecture, HowTo, Reference, Explanation, Tutorial
not_independent_types.handling: Document subtypes or path families; retain source subtype/fields, do not duplicate same file under an extra canonical identity.

not_independent_types.name: FlowNode / FlowStep / Branch
not_independent_types.handling: Nested Flow schema members with source-relative identities. Their detailed metadata may use owned subnodes if necessary, not independent top-level source artifacts.

not_independent_types.name: Pattern
not_independent_types.handling: AC schema declares implements_pattern, pattern_bindings and pattern_slots, but no separate canonical Pattern store/schema was found in the scanned registries/components. Preserve declared fields and references without synthesizing a separate authority.

not_independent_types.name: Lesson, Mistake, Observation, Policy
not_independent_types.handling: Concept proposal and/or synthetic example types exist, but no independently validated canonical store was found. Do not turn proposed concepts or arbitrary prose into records with invented fields.

not_independent_types.name: Flow Markdown, AgentCard, product-truth derived indexes, decision index, roadmap renderings
not_independent_types.handling: Generated views of canonical records; avoid duplicate nodes.

not_independent_types.name: FeedbackRecord
not_independent_types.handling: Runtime JSONL under debugging/logs/feedback.jsonl. Shape owned by templates/scripts/feedback/submit_feedback.py and resolve_feedback.py. Not an immutable Git snapshot source; inventory as a separately governed future runtime ingestion surface.

not_independent_types.name: AgentTelemetry, KnowledgeEmission, RunEnvelope, EvidenceBundle, HumanInteraction, CapabilityGap, query activation receipts
not_independent_types.handling: Runtime events/transport/checkpoint contracts, not canonical repository record types. Their schema catalog must not be mistaken for Git record inventory.

not_independent_types.name: Repository, Snapshot, query catalog indexes, vector labels
not_independent_types.handling: Projection/storage metadata, not user-domain canonical record kinds.

not_independent_types.name: Configuration/schema definitions, hooks, workflow implementations
not_independent_types.handling: SourceFile or Document when referenced, unless a distinct registry record above supplies a native entity contract.
